review_findings.scope: full modeled ligand under residue-level operational criteria
review_findings.wording_limit: Frozen policy says occupancy_min at residue level but does not explicitly name the average; code and report use wwPDB avgoccu. Do not claim atom-level occupancy>=0.9 or every atom resolved.

review_findings.interpretation: Passes operational threshold with an explicit structural caution; numerical tolerance does not determine classification.

reviewer_interpretation: Full modeled ligand passes the operational residue criteria is defensible; unique atomic truth is not established.
